text:
maya.k: quick heads-up — failing Go SDK validation when optional numeric 'score' comes through as null vs omitted. example payload from client: ```json
{"user":"u_42","score":null,"note":"early beta"}
```
error: "funcall validation: score: expected integer, got null"

jonah.r: can you paste the exact runtime dump and which validator invoked it?

maya.k: runtime log: ```
funcvalidator: field="score" requiredType=int optional=true raw=null validator=struct
```

evan.p: this is Go json.Unmarshal behavior — null -> nil for pointers/interface; our struct-based validator expects a concrete int. In TS/Py we tolerate null->missing for optionals more often.

nimisha: we've also seen problems when the response is streamed: chunk 3 contains `"score":null` and SDK validates incrementally and fails before the final chunk merges. That makes streaming flaky under retries.

jonah.r: short-term mitigation: treat explicit null as absent for fields marked optional. But be careful: we must NOT drop explicit nulls for required fields.

maya.k: thinking of a helper: `NormalizeFuncOutput(out map[string]interface{}, schema Schema, opts NormalizeOpts) map[string]interface{}` that: 
- merges streamed partial chunks into a single object (if streaming)
- converts optional field nulls -> delete(field)
- preserves nil for required fields and returns validation error later

devex-bot: CI report: go-unit tests failing: redwood-go-sdk/tests/func_null_stream_boundary_test — rerun? use /rerun-ci

evan.p: code sketch: ```go
func NormalizeFuncOutput(out map[string]interface{}, schema Schema) map[string]interface{} {
  for k,v := range out {
    if schema.IsOptional(k) && v == nil {
      delete(out, k) // treat null as missing
    }
  }
  return out
}
```

nimisha: +1 but add MergeStreamChunks(rawChunks [][]byte) (map[string]interface{}, error) to ensure Normalize runs on the final merged payload, not per-chunk. Also add logic to ignore trailing-comma partials and resume correctly on retry.

jonah.r: good call. I'll add two flags: `ValidateAtEnd bool` and `NormalizeOptionalNulls bool` on the SDK client config so teams can opt-in before we flip defaults.

maya.k: opened WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go-sdk/pull/514 — includes Normalize helper + unit test `TestNormalizeOptionalNulls` and a streaming integration `TestStreamRetryNullBoundary`. cc @jonah.r @evan.p

jonah.r: reviewing. main requests: 
- keep pointer semantics for typed SDK consumers (don't coerce int pointers to absent if consumer used *int)
- ensure errors include field path for nested objects (e.g., metadata.metrics.score)
- unit tests for required vs optional differencing

maya.k: will add tests tonight. Also replicating in TS/Python is necessary; I'll open companion tickets.

evan.p: one more gotcha — auth retry/reconnect: when we replay buffered streamed deltas we should re-run Merge+Normalize on the concatenated buffer, not on each replayed delta. Otherwise intermittent failures crop up.

nimisha: adding integration that simulates token expiry mid-stream + replay of buffered chunks with `score` null at chunk boundary.

jonah.r: plan of record: 
1) Add MergeStreamChunks util (Go)
2) Add NormalizeOptionalNulls helper + config flag
3) Delay strict validation until end of stream if ValidateAtEnd enabled
4) Mirror helpers in TS/Py with same opt-in flags
5) Backport minimal patch to 1.x if tests pass

maya.k: thanks — I'll update PR with test coverage and link the TS/Python tickets. ping for review after CI green. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: rerun scheduled for go-unit (tests/func_null_stream_boundary_test)
